authorInfo.bio: William Holmes McGuffey (1800–1873) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The New McGuffey First Reader" by William Holmes McGuffey is an educational text written during the late 19th century. This book serves as an instructional primer designed for early readers, introducing them to the fundamentals of reading through engaging stories and exercises.
